cap_notes.task_cap_usd: Maximum cost for a single customer service interaction (one user message → one agent response cycle). At $0.034 average, this gives 47% headroom for complex cases.
cap_notes.session_cap_usd: Maximum cost for a full multi-turn conversation session (typically 3–5 task cycles). Prevents expensive escalation chains from spiraling.
cap_notes.daily_cap_usd: Aggregate daily spend across all agent instances. At $0.034/session this supports ~1,470 sessions/day before the cap. Sized for current traffic.
cap_notes.sprint_cap_usd: Two-week sprint budget. At $50/day this supports 10 full working days. Includes buffer for load spikes and experiments.
cap_notes.monthly_cap_usd: Hard monthly ceiling. Aligns with finance-approved AI spend envelope. Sprint caps enforce this indirectly.

threshold_notes.warn: At 80% utilization, emit gate=warn and notify via webhook. Allow execution to continue. Log to spend ledger.
threshold_notes.block: At 100% utilization (projected cost >= cap), halt execution immediately. Emit gate=block with remediation suggestions.
threshold_notes.early_warning: At 60% utilization for sprint/monthly caps, send early warning to POD Lead. No execution halt.

alert_conditions.message_template: Task {task_id} projected at {utilization_pct}% of ${task_cap_usd} cap (${projected_usd}). Gate: warn.
BLOCKED: Task {task_id} projected at {utilization_pct}% of ${task_cap_usd} cap (${projected_usd}). Execution halted.
Daily spend at {utilization_pct}% of ${daily_cap_usd} cap (${daily_spend_usd} spent today).
DAILY CAP REACHED: All new agent tasks blocked until UTC midnight. Spent: ${daily_spend_usd}.
Sprint spend early warning: {utilization_pct}% of ${sprint_cap_usd} budget used. {sprint_days_remaining} days remaining.
Sprint spend at {utilization_pct}% of ${sprint_cap_usd}. Consider deferring non-critical agent tasks.

overrides.override_notes: A POD Lead can approve a one-time override up to 2x the cap for a specific task_id. Override must be logged to the audit trail before execution proceeds.

startup_mvp.notes: Tight caps for pre-revenue MVP. Forces use of Haiku for all non-critical steps.

growth_stage.notes: Current profile. Balanced quality/cost for 1K–2K sessions/day.

enterprise_scale.notes: High-volume deployment with SLA requirements allowing Sonnet for more steps.
